description: MCP catalog for Sera — multi-currency stablecoin FX settled on the Sera appchain. Keyless, non-custodial, Streamable HTTP transport.

sera.description: Sera FX gateway (keyless): quote + settlement-intent, plus reference rates, corridors, and the read/analytics suite (deals, spread radar, depth, corridor comparison).

sera-local.description: Full Sera MCP (~55 tools incl. treasury, orders, execution, plus accounts, mandates and receipts on the appchain) run locally via npx. Node 20+. Uses your own signer/API key.
